addr: 140, 1st Main Rd, 4th Block, S.T. Bed, S T Bed Layout, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560047, India

rev.t: Here's my review after staying for 1 and half months. After I got married, I was looking for a place to stay on an emergency basis. So I called the owner one month ago, at the time, he said rent is 30K, but didn't say a word about advance …

Best PG to stay in Bangalore. My workplace is little far from Koramangala but I still stayed here because of the management. The team here is very friendly and the food is good. The owner and the manager here are very friendly and helpful. …

One of the best women’s PGs I’ve stayed in! The food is genuinely good — homely, fresh, and consistent. Rooms are clean, the environment is safe, and the staff is really helpful. Perfect for students and working women
